title: Secure Remote Access and Least Privilege
objective: Harden accounts, SSH, sudo, file ownership, and permissions.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: SSH protects remote transport, but security still depends on identity and policy. Prefer keys, disable direct root login, remove unused accounts, and restrict sudo commands.
Least privilege applies to processes and files as well as people. Explicit owners, groups, and modes reduce accidental access; validate SSH configuration before reload.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Harden accounts, SSH, sudo, file ownership, and permissions.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
access_policy:
  root_login: disabled
  authentication: ssh_keys
  sudo: restricted
  file_permissions: explicit
